name: @kb/design-tokens
description: Shared visual tokens for apps/web and apps/widget (docs/19 §27). ZERO dependencies and ZERO devDependencies on purpose: with shared-workspace-lockfile=false a single devDependency would write a fifth pnpm-lock.yaml, so the build is a Node-builtins-only script. It ships CSS and JSON, never markup — which is why apps/web's globals.css needs no @source for it.
